external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Wilshire Trails: Wilshire Trails is a 30-home neighborhood development located just off East 33rd Street North and Peoria in Tulsa, located in the growing Phoenix District. A project of Green Country Habitat for Humanity, Wilshire Trails offers residents close access to public transportation and is conveniently located near Educare, Crossover Community Center, Tisdale OU Medical Clinic and the Peoria Mohawk Industrial Park. Learn more from Green Country Habitat for Humanity.

36N Envision Comanche Project is a $190 million multi-year investment to transform the 36th Street North corridor into a mixed-use, mixed-income community for north Tulsans. A Tulsa Housing Authority property, The Phoenix at 36N aims to highlight, enhance and improve economic opportunity and prosperity within north Tulsa. In 2026, The Phoenix at 36N is 100% occupied. Discover 36N on their website.
